$comment: Gameplay numbers. No tunable constant lives in a logic file; everything here is validated by schema at server start and can be hot reloaded from the admin page.

flight.$comment: Top speed and max turn rate follow from thrust-to-mass and torque-to-inertia on these curves, so a design's handling falls out of its layout rather than a per-hull table.

thrusters.$comment: A maneuvering thruster further from the centre of mass has more leverage. The reference arm sets how much layout matters: torque is strength * (1 + arm / referenceArm).

mass.$comment: Cargo and Propellant are carried mass, so a full hold flies worse than an empty one.

hull.$comment: A ship is written off when its bridge is destroyed or total structure falls below this share of its intact structure.

licences.$comment: Hull licences cap module count and grid extent. Named in spec section 7.

ports.$comment: What a berth charges. The Staple prices Propellant properly in M4; until then these are the port's own rates.

start.$comment: What a captain is given when they are first entered in the Register. Marks can be overridden per server; the draught and the opening Ordnance are the game's own. Propellant is not listed because it is filled to whatever the draught's tanks hold: a new captain never reads a figure their hull cannot carry.

law.$comment: What the Prize Court charges for firing on lawful traffic. A composition is struck per point of damage dealt — shields included, because the offence is the attack and not whether it got through — plus a flat sum for a hull written off, and both are weighted by how much law reaches the system: the Home Roads at full, the Concessions lightly, the Marque not at all. A posted captain is refused at Home Roads berths until it is paid.

world.$comment: spawnStandoff is how far off a berth a captain who has never flown, or who has just been written off, is set down: short enough that the berth is on screen and the landing prompt is already up, so the first thing a new captain sees is where they are. The Unlettered hold further out, in open space between the berths, and scatter about their anchor. Where a hull arrives from a lane comes from the system's own radius, not from here.

patrolsBySecurity.$comment: How many of the Prize Court's patrols stand in a system. They answer for the Home Roads and keep a thinner watch over the Concessions; the Marque has none.

raidersBySecurity.$comment: How many Unlettered hunt a system, by how much law reaches it. The Home Roads are patrolled, so nothing hunts there; the Marque is nobody's.
